paragraphs: The Discovery Tdi was fitted to the original Discovery (D1/L318) from 1989 to 1998. Across this production run, the vehicle used two distinct variants of the same 2.5-litre diesel family: the earlier 200Tdi and the later 300Tdi. Both are mechanical-injection four-cylinder diesels, and both are known for their durability when properly maintained — though they have distinct component specifications that matter when rebuilding. The key difference between the two engines is that the timing belt interval is critical on both, and servicing history is often the difference between a reliable Discovery and one that needs early cylinder head work. The Discovery Tdi is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road. Land Rover Discovery Tdi Engine Codes 200Tdi (D1/L318, 1989–1994) A 2.5-litre four-cylinder diesel fitted to early Discovery Tdi models. One of Land Rover's most durable mechanical-injection diesel engines. The timing belt interval and cooling system condition are critical to longevity, and we service every 200Tdi rebuild to the same high standard. Check Your 200Tdi Discovery → [link to quote form] 300Tdi (D1/L318, 1994–1998) A 2.5-litre four-cylinder diesel fitted to later Discovery Tdi models. An evolution of the 200Tdi with improvements to the cooling system and ancillaries. We service every 300Tdi rebuild to the same high standard. Check Your 300Tdi Discovery → [link to quote form] Land Rover Discovery Tdi Engine Compatibility The Discovery Tdi uses one of two mechanical-injection diesel engines — the 200Tdi or the 300Tdi. While they share the same displacement and basic architecture, they have different component specifications and external arrangements. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm: Your exact engine code (200Tdi or 300Tdi) via registration or VIN Your vehicle's build year (1989–1994 for 200Tdi, 1994–1998 for 300Tdi) Any modifications or ancillaries specific to your exact build This is why we always start with your registration rather than a generic Discovery Tdi quote — it protects you from paying for parts that don't fit your actual vehicle. The Discovery Tdi uses either the 200Tdi or 300Tdi — both 2.5-litre four-cylinder diesel engines. The 200Tdi was fitted from 1989 to 1994, and the 300Tdi from 1994 to 1998. Send us your registration and we'll confirm which one your vehicle has. How much does a Land Rover Discovery Tdi engine rebuild cost? Rebuilds start from £1,900, for either engine code. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote. Which engine code is fitted to my Discovery Tdi? Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm whether you have the 200Tdi or the 300Tdi before you're quoted anything. Do you rebuild 200Tdi Discovery engines? Yes. We replace the timing belt, injectors, head gasket and cooling system components as standard on every 200Tdi rebuild. Do you rebuild 300Tdi Discovery engines? Yes. The 300Tdi is an evolution of the 200Tdi, and we service it to the same high standard. Do you supply used Discovery Tdi engines? Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation. Can you recover my Discovery Tdi if the engine has failed? Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking. How long does a Discovery Tdi engine rebuild take? Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your vehicle arrives at our workshop. Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine? For most Discovery Tdi owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty — often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers. cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the Discovery Tdi from 2023 to present. The 200Tdi or 300Tdi features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older 200Tdi or 300Tdi V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every 200Tdi or 300Tdi rebuild.
